name: Airtable CRM
author: hearth-team
description: Read and write lead/CRM records in your Airtable base (pairs well with leads_finder). action='add' creates a record (args: fields — an object of column-name → value, e.g. {"Name":"Ada","Email":"ada@x.com","Status":"New"}). action='list' returns records (args: max default 20 max 100, view optional). action='update' patches a record (args: record_id (required, rec…), fields (required object)). Bring your own AIRTABLE_API_KEY (a personal access token with data.records:read + data.records:write), base_id, and table_name (default 'Leads').

vault_inputs.label: Airtable personal access token
vault_inputs.help: Create at https://airtable.com/create/tokens → grant the 'data.records:read' AND 'data.records:write' scopes → add access to the base you want to use. Starts with 'pat'. Stored encrypted in your vault.

vault_inputs.label: Base ID
vault_inputs.help: The base id — find it in the base URL (airtable.com/appXXXX/...) or at https://airtable.com/api. Starts with 'app'.

vault_inputs.label: Table name
vault_inputs.help: The table to read/write. Defaults to 'Leads'. Use the exact table name as shown in Airtable (case-sensitive).
